sources.label: Official Fred Perry UK men's size guide (Top Half, letter sizes, cm)

audit: Was XS–XXL with single chest/waist values and UK 34–44 / US / EU conversions that Fred Perry doesn't publish for menswear. Official letter chart gives chest only, as cm ranges, XS–XXXL: XS 85 → 81–86, M 94 → 97–102, L 100 → 104–109, XXL 112 → 119–124; XXXL added. Waist and UK/US/EU removed (waist is only given for numeric trouser sizes). Fred Perry also publishes a numeric chest-size chart (36–46 = 92–117 cm) for items sized that way; not stored here. Old /size-guide URL is a 404.
notes: Iconic British mod heritage brand. Men's clothing is sized either S/M/L (chest ranges) or by chest size 36–46. Classic twin-tipped polo is their signature — cuts tend slim and short in the body.
